name: Zscaler — DLP Block on Upload to Cloud Storage (Insider Exfil)
xql_query:
dataset = zscaler_nssweblog_raw
| filter act = "Blocked"
| filter reason = "DLP Block"
| filter src != null and suser != null
| alter src_ip = src, user_name = suser, url = request, dlp_rule = cs3, dst_ip = dst
description: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action with reason=DLP Block — insider uploading sensitive data (Source Code / PII) to external cloud storage (Online Storage category, e.g. mega.nz). Correlated to the insider by src and suser.
alert_name: Zscaler — DLP Block on Upload to Cloud Storage (Insider Exfil)
alert_description:
What fired: Zscaler NSS web log Blocked action with reason=DLP Block — insider uploading sensitive data (Source Code / PII) to external cloud storage (Online Storage category, e.g. mega.nz). Correlated to the insider by src and suser.

Why it matters: data may be leaving the environment through this channel. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1567.002 - Exfiltration to Cloud Storage (TA0010 - Exfiltration).

Investigate:
  - Quantify the volume and destination, and identify the user/host/principal moving the data.
  - Correlate with prior collection/staging and any defense-evasion steps; confirm the destination is not an approved service.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
